claim_boundary: B0 is target-label-free transfer with target static context; its blend candidate is selected only by source-city LOCO and falls back to the rigid anchor when the source gate fails. B100 is target offline adaptation over the same source-selected blend. The primary target-only comparator uses the identical anchor, correction, blend candidate, hyperparameters and B100 group identifiers while consuming zero source rows; the earlier low-capacity strict target-only model is retained only as a secondary artifact. All models use the audited pure halted-vehicle 450-second target and remain development models until nested source weighting and fresh closed-loop confirmation pass.
